title: SMPTE LTC
hero_prompt: A wide Bauhaus-style geometric screenprint of a single unbroken waveform ribbon threading through and phase-locking a row of gear-wheels and clock-faces of different sizes, flat bold color blocks in primary red, black, and ochre. No letters, numerals, words, labels, or inscriptions — purely pictorial. Hand-made Bauhaus geometric screenprint, with visible ink, brush or print texture on paper; flat and graphic, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field, no glossy highlights.
icon_prompt: A bold screenprint emblem of one thick zigzag waveform pulse locked inside a single gear-tooth circle, flat high-contrast black-on-white silhouette. No fine linework, no letters or text — reads clearly at small size.
